title: Declared-budget admission
summary: Refuse a unit when the operator says they have fewer minutes than it costs. Never invent a quota number.
spec:
Create sparefold/budget.py with admission(remaining_minutes, budget_minutes) -> bool and load_remaining(path) -> int | None.

Contract, checked by projects/self/checks/check_self_002.py:
- remaining_minutes is None means undeclared. Return True. Do not invent a number and do not call a provider.
- negative remaining_minutes raises ValueError.
- budget_minutes < 1 raises ValueError.
- otherwise return True only when remaining_minutes >= budget_minutes.
- load_remaining on a missing path returns None.
- a JSON object {"remaining_minutes": <int>} returns that int.
- any other JSON shape raises ValueError.
- Do not read environment variables, API keys, or the network.
- Do not edit the checker.
